what_this_is: The pinned Mixin transformer run in a plain JVM over independently compiled target and mixin classes (two mixin configs standing in for two mods). Not a Minecraft run: no game class, no fabric-loader, no transforming classloader.

static_checks.InjectionPoint.checkPriority.reading: returns true iff targetPriority < mixinPriority (iload_1, iload_2, if_icmpge)

scenarios.question: Does an @Overwrite from one mod remove a HEAD/TAIL @Inject on the same method from another mod (equal priority 1000)?
scenarios.setup: moda A_Overwrite: @Overwrite run(); modb A_Inject: @Inject HEAD and TAIL into run()
